mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals labor market tightness that precedes monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion when UNRATE < 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO > 105.0 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) fall below 2200.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a cooling housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of HOUST < 2200.0 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% and an unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market weakness, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE > 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economic regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, which reduces corporate output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in supply-constrained regimes when INDPRO < 105.0 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
